text: Croatia spent 420 million euros to avoid 20 kilometers of Bosnia.
Some countries got the seas leftovers.
DR Congo is Africa's second biggest country and gets just 37 kilometers of coastline.
Iraq has over 430,000 square kilometers of land and 58 kilometers of coast.
Jordan has 26 kilometers, squeezed onto the Red Sea at Acaba. Bosnia and Herzegovina has about 20 kilometers, and one seaside town, Naom.
